title: TypeError: Cannot read property 'map' of undefined
error:
TypeError: Cannot read property 'map' of undefined
    at UserList (UserList.jsx:15:23)
    at renderWithHooks (react-dom.development.js:14985:18)
context: Fetching users from API, component renders before data arrives
solution: Add optional chaining: users?.map() or initialize state with empty array

title: CORS policy blocked request
error: Access to XMLHttpRequest at 'https://api.example.com' from origin 'http://localhost:3000' has been blocked by CORS policy
context: Making API calls from local dev server to production API
solution: Add proxy in package.json or configure CORS headers on backend

title: Module not found: Can't resolve 'axios'
error: Module not found: Error: Can't resolve 'axios' in '/app/src'
context: Fresh clone of repo, ran npm start without npm install
solution: Run npm install to install dependencies

title: PostgreSQL connection refused
error:
ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:5432
Error: connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:5432
context: Starting Node.js app, PostgreSQL service not running
solution: Start PostgreSQL: sudo systemctl start postgresql

title: JWT token expired
error:
JsonWebTokenError: jwt expired
    at Jwt.verify (/node_modules/jsonwebtoken/verify.js:133:19)
context: User session expired after 1 hour, getting 401 on all requests
solution: Implement refresh token flow or extend token expiry in config

title: Git merge conflict in package-lock.json
error:
CONFLICT (content): Merge conflict in package-lock.json
Automatic merge failed; fix conflicts and then commit the result.
context: Merging feature branch into main after teammate updated dependencies
solution: Delete package-lock.json, run npm install, then commit the new lock file

title: Docker container exits immediately
error: Container exited with code 0
context: Running docker-compose up, container starts and stops instantly
solution: Add 'tty: true' to docker-compose.yml or ensure CMD keeps process running

title: ESLint parsing error: Unexpected token
context: Using class properties syntax without proper babel config
solution: Install @babel/plugin-proposal-class-properties and add to .babelrc

title: Python ImportError: No module named 'requests'
error:
ImportError: No module named 'requests'
  File "app.py", line 1, in <module>
    import requests
context: Running Python script in new virtual environment
solution: pip install requests (or pip install -r requirements.txt)

title: React useEffect infinite loop
error: Warning: Maximum update depth exceeded. This can happen when a component calls setState inside useEffect
context: useEffect with object dependency causing re-renders
solution: Use useMemo for object dependencies or spread specific properties in dep array

title: TypeScript: Property does not exist on type
error: TS2339: Property 'name' does not exist on type '{}'
context: API response typed as empty object, accessing properties fails
solution: Define proper interface for API response and type the fetch result

title: npm ERR! ERESOLVE unable to resolve dependency tree
error:
npm ERR! ERESOLVE unable to resolve dependency tree
npm ERR! peer dep missing: react@^17.0.0
context: Installing package that requires React 17 but project uses React 18
solution: Use --legacy-peer-deps flag or find compatible package version

title: MongoDB connection timeout
error:
MongooseServerSelectionError: connection timed out
    at Timeout._onTimeout
context: Connecting to MongoDB Atlas from local machine
solution: Whitelist IP address in MongoDB Atlas Network Access settings

title: CSS z-index not working
error: Modal appears behind other elements despite high z-index
context: Modal component with z-index: 9999 still hidden behind sidebar
solution: Parent element needs position: relative and creates new stacking context. Move modal to body root.

title: AWS S3 Access Denied
error:
AccessDenied: Access Denied
    at Request.extractError (s3.js:711:35)
context: Uploading file to S3 bucket from Lambda function
solution: Add s3:PutObject permission to Lambda execution role IAM policy

title: Next.js hydration mismatch
error: Warning: Text content did not match. Server: "Dec 15" Client: "Dec 16"
context: Rendering dates on server vs client in different timezones
solution: Use useEffect for client-only date formatting or suppressHydrationWarning

title: Tailwind classes not applying
error: Tailwind utility classes have no effect on elements
context: Added new component, Tailwind styles not working
solution: Add component path to content array in tailwind.config.js

title: Redis WRONGTYPE Operation error
error: WRONGTYPE Operation against a key holding the wrong kind of value
context: Trying to GET a key that was set with HSET
solution: Use HGET/HGETALL for hash keys, or delete and recreate with correct type

title: GitHub Actions workflow failing
error:
Error: Process completed with exit code 1.
npm test failed
context: CI pipeline failing on test step after adding new tests
solution: Tests were using local env vars not set in CI. Added secrets to GitHub repo settings.

title: Prisma migration failed
error: Error: P3009 migrate found failed migrations in the target database
context: Running prisma migrate deploy on production database
solution: Mark failed migration as rolled back: prisma migrate resolve --rolled-back

title: Webpack build out of memory
error: FATAL ERROR: CALL_AND_RETRY_LAST Allocation failed - JavaScript heap out of memory
context: Building large React app with many dependencies
solution: Increase Node memory: NODE_OPTIONS=--max_old_space_size=4096 npm run build

title: SSL certificate problem: self signed certificate
error: curl: (60) SSL certificate problem: self signed certificate in certificate chain
context: Calling internal API with self-signed cert from Node.js
solution: Set NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 for dev, or add CA cert to trusted store

title: React key prop warning
error: Warning: Each child in a list should have a unique "key" prop
context: Rendering list of items without key attribute
solution: Add unique key prop to each list item: key={item.id}

title: Vercel deployment environment variables missing
error: Error: Missing required environment variable: DATABASE_URL
context: Deployed to Vercel but forgot to add env vars in dashboard
solution: Add environment variables in Vercel project settings > Environment Variables

title: Jest test timeout exceeded
error: Timeout - Async callback was not invoked within the 5000 ms timeout
context: Testing async function that makes API call
solution: Increase timeout: jest.setTimeout(30000) or mock the API call
